Heavy Rain Causes Waterlogging, Officials Face Scrutiny

Following a brief period of rain, several areas experienced significant waterlogging, leading to questions about municipal preparedness. Officials have been warned to take responsibility for the situation, with a focus on accountability for urban infrastructure failures. The event highlights ongoing challenges in managing urban flooding during monsoon seasons.
